#!/bin/sh
set -eu
uv=/home/kali/.hermes/cache/scratch/omnis-p1-tools/uv-venv/bin/uv
private_dns=false
case "${1-}:${2-}" in
    audit:*|pip:sync|pip:install) private_dns=true ;;
esac
if [ "$private_dns" = true ]; then
    exec /usr/bin/unshare --user --map-root-user --mount --propagation private /bin/sh -eu -c '
        /usr/bin/mount --bind "$1" /etc/nsswitch.conf
        /usr/bin/mount -o remount,bind,ro /etc/nsswitch.conf
        shift
        exec "$@"
    ' sh /home/kali/.hermes/cache/scratch/omnis-b03-a02-nsswitch.conf "$uv" "$@"
fi
exec "$uv" "$@"

# Private NSS override for the audit child only.
passwd: files systemd winbind
group: files systemd winbind
shadow: files systemd
gshadow: files systemd
hosts: files dns myhostname
networks: files
protocols: db files
services: db files
ethers: db files
rpc: db files
netgroup: nis
